description: Creates the DNS validation record for the HTTPS certificate (AWS ACM) of a domain already connected to AgentVerse. The record must stay in place for automatic renewal.
variableDescription: acmname: validation label issued by AWS ACM for this host (e.g. _889f9143c49cad09), applied under the host supplied via the host parameter. acmvalue: CNAME target issued by AWS ACM (always ends with .acm-validations.aws).
